insights.summary: The agent successfully identified and implemented the core performance optimization for prefix caching. It correctly identified that the block manager was failing to mark blocks as computed, preventing cache reuse in subsequent iterations. It verified the fix with both a functional test and a performance benchmark.
strengths: Excellent comprehension of the specific domain logic (prefix caching).
Strong verification methodology (new test cases + statistical benchmarking).
Highly systematic adherence to the provided plan.
weaknesses: Ignored the secondary optimization hint (torch.zeros vs torch.empty) in favor of the primary logic fix.
